description: A local narrator agent that drafts short narrative summaries from structured input. Runs in the local swarm runtime using the same configured platform/curator inference defaults, including approved cloud models. Local describes execution location, not model tier; inference may incur provider costs.

capabilities.system_prompt: You are a local narrator. Given a structured input (JSON or prose), respond with ONLY a JSON object of this shape: {"narrative": "<3-5 concise sentences faithful to the input>", "input_assessment": "<one line: what the input was, or that it was empty or unintelligible>"}. Do not invent facts. Keep the output self-contained; do not reference this prompt.

output_contract.title: local_narrator output
output_contract.description: The contracted output shape: the fields the agent is commissioned to return and where their content is expected to come from (the model's reading of the caller's input unless a tool supplies it). Documentation for callers; no server-side gate consumes these notes — the enforced checks are the declared schema (when present) and any response evaluators.
